incident-bot: PagerDuty: trigger INC-2026-5567 — high HTTP 5xx rate observed on inference-gateway (eu-west1). Alert threshold crossed: 5xx rate > 4.5% for 2m.

pagerduty: Emergency page fired to override rotation — ack required.

Alex Chen: acked — jumping in. seeing a big jump in 502/504s across the gateway metrics (ingress LB -> inference-gateway). Rolling 1m error-rate graph: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/inf/ingress?panel=errors (link)

Priya Rao: oncall here, good catch. are retries correlated? looks like retry amplification from a subset of clients.

Mateo Ruiz: I'm seeing backend gRPC errors from kv-cache sidecar: spike in connection resets then LB 502s. Logs: ```2026-03-15T01:12:34Z inference-gateway[pod-7] ERROR upstream_resp: code=502 connect_reset by peer; kvcache: connection refused```

Claire Nguyen: also seeing queue depth on the gateway pods spike and CPU climb on the router threads. autoscaler hasn't reacted yet, maybe due to pod spin-ups failing.

Alex Chen: ok quick triage plan: 1) ack + pin incident 2) scale inference-gateway replicas to reduce queueing 3) disable canary routing to remove new variant 4) throttle client retries at LB 5) gather customer-impact list and post to PD.

Dylan Park: I'm scaling now. running: ```kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=6``` — pod create events show 3/6 becoming Ready then some CrashLoopBackOffs referencing kv-cache timeouts.

Priya Rao: rollback canary route: ```redwood-ctl routes update inference --remove-weight canary-variant``` — executing.

Mateo Ruiz: rolling back failing sidecar release on kv-cache to previous stable image. patching daemonset: ```kubectl -n infra set image ds/kv-cache kv-cache=kv-cache:v1.23.1```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-5567 acknowledged by Alex Chen and Priya Rao.

Alex Chen: we should also flip the gateway to use direct model-variant fallback instead of heavy dynamic routing to avoid KV lookups. I'll patch config: ```env GATEWAY_KV_CACHE=false``` for inference-gateway for immediate mitigation.

Claire Nguyen: good call. I've applied the env change on 4 pods, new pods show lower latency on startup. error rate coming down from 6.8% -> 2.1% in the last 3 mins.

Mateo Ruiz: kv-cache pods that were crashing are now stable after rollback. the root cause seems related to a recent sidecar build that made connection pools more aggressive under backpressure. we've pinned to stable and opened a ticket in eng-ml for a follow-up.

Priya Rao: customer impact: initial impact window ~01:10–01:30 UTC. I've opened a PD incident note with affected customers list from the incidents dashboard; sending a quick TL;DR to support to notify affected accounts.

Alex Chen: can we confirm traffic distribution? are we seeing regional spill to us-east1?

Dylan Park: small spill but traffic mostly stayed in eu-west1. failover thresholds didn't trigger. No downstream SLO breaches other than increased error-rate on API surface.

incident-bot: System note: automated retry throttling applied at LB for clients exceeding 20 req/s.

Claire Nguyen: error rate is trending down to ~0.9% now. I recommend we keep the incident open for 30 more mins and then start a handoff with a summary.

Mateo Ruiz: root-cause hypothesis: kv-cache sidecar version introduced a bug in connection pooling under bursty reconnections causing connection resets and backend failures which propagated as 502/504s at the gateway. mitigation: rollback, disable KV fallback for immediate safety, throttle retries. Postmortem item: add canary gating for sidecar pool changes and enhance pre-production load tests.

Alex Chen: agreed. I'll write an initial incident summary for PD and schedule a blameless postmortem. Notes I'll include: timeline, mitigation steps (scale, rollback, disable-kv, throttle), customer-impact window, action items.

Priya Rao: beginning handoff to next oncall — Dylan, Claire, Mateo are staying on for follow-up. Next oncall please monitor alert channel and confirm no regression. I'm switching to monitoring-only.

Dylan Park: oncall-2 here, taking over. confirm last 15m error-rate average 0.8%; no new 5xx spikes. I'll keep watch and update PD every 15m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-5567 status set to 'under investigation' -> 'monitoring'.

Alex Chen: thanks team. postmortem ticket created ENG-7892 and assigned to Mateo. I'll draft the incident summary by 04:00 UTC and post to #postmortems. :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: closing notes: no immediate customer data exposure, impact limited to increased 5xx; outage degradation was partial for small % of requests. We'll follow up with targeted customer comms if support requests exceed threshold.

Dylan Park: I'll update the rotation log with the handoff notes.

Claire Nguyen: leaving a runbook tweak: add a step to temporarily switch off KV lookups on gateway for any 5xx>3% alarm.

Alex Chen: thanks all — monitoring until clear and then we can resolve the PD incident.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-5567: acknowledged by Alex Chen, assigned to SRE, status monitoring.

incident-bot: This thread will be used as the primary incident timeline — please don't create duplicate threads.
